claim.summary: Pointwise residual and positive-gap evidence over a finite coordinate list, plus scalar side conditions, construct the bundled coordinate-envelope checklist and imply shifted dominance for every coordinate in the list.
list_inputs: forall p in coords, residual a b p <= B
forall p in coords, δ <= a - p.1
claim.constructed_certificate: CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ coords
claim.conclusion: forall p in coords, shiftedSqMod c p.1 p.2 < shiftedSqMod c a b

proves: pointwise residual evidence builds a residual envelope
pointwise positive-gap evidence builds a positive-gap envelope
finite-list checklist evidence implies shifted dominance for every coordinate
does_not_prove: that any coordinate is an eigenvalue
that the coordinate list is a matrix spectrum
actual spectrum extraction from a matrix
construction of B from a matrix spectrum
construction of δ from a matrix spectral gap
strict spectral-abscissa hypothesis for a matrix eigenvalue
that a strict-abscissa eigenvalue of a real matrix is real
